probe_overhead: Approximately 47–64 ns per allocator operation in the isolated 96-byte microbenchmark; not an end-to-end overhead measurement.
causal_limit: Off-CPU stalls outside allocator calls rule out allocator contention as the sole explanation of this run. No scheduler-state evidence, so preemption versus kernel/page-fault wait remains unresolved. Does not establish cause of historical CI failures.
